d:
Khubsurat baveriyan aalps, parvatarohiyon aur haik par jane valon ki pasandida jagah rahe hain. lekin laparvahi ya achanak badalte mausam ki vajah se jab yahan musibat aati hai, tab maunten reskyu tim hi bachav karti hai.
Blauaais gleshiyar par ek maunteniyar mushkil men hai. vah akela hai aur ghana kohra chha jane ki vajah se aage nahin barh pa raha. tab ramzau maunten reskyu sarvis ki ek tim vahan pahunchti hai, lekin ye kohra unke lie bhi aafat ban jata hai. do timen, alag-alag taraf se us shakhs ko dhunrhti hain, jo shayad thand ki chapet men aa chuka hoga.
